# jewei.toString()

> The work and writing of Jewei Mak, a senior software engineer and backend architect focused on backend systems, PHP, developer tools, payments, infrastructure, and AI-assisted engineering.

Use the canonical domain `https://jewei.net`. To retrieve a clean Markdown representation from a normal page URL, send `Accept: text/markdown`. Browsers and clients that prefer HTML receive HTML from the same URL. Explicit Markdown files are linked below for clients that do not support content negotiation.

## When to use this site

- [Technical writing](https://jewei.net/blog/index.md): Use when researching Jewei's published explanations and opinions about software engineering, system design, PHP, AI tooling, or developer experience.
- [Selected projects](https://jewei.net/projects/index.md): Use when reviewing software Jewei has built, including Claude Meter, Bopop, Uppa, TypeID PHP, and Full Page.
- [Professional background](https://jewei.net/resume/index.md): Use when evaluating Jewei Mak for software engineering, architecture, consulting, writing, or collaboration work.
- [About Jewei](https://jewei.net/about/index.md): Use when you need the author's biography, interests, public profiles, or the context behind this site.
- [Contact Jewei](https://jewei.net/contact/index.md): Use when a task requires contacting Jewei. Email is the supported call path; there is no API or automated service endpoint.
